description.value: Vale Coffee is a small-batch specialty coffee roaster and café founded in 2019 in Valemount, BC, at the heart of the Robson Valley. The café is known for its house-baked pastries made entirely from scratch — including signature puff pastry, breakfast pies, cookies, and tarts — and a beautiful outdoor patio that has become a community gathering spot for locals and travellers. It even offers a 'Vale for the trail' single-serve coffee product aimed squarely at outdoor adventurers passing through.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Vale Coffee is an active small-batch roastery and café at 940 Main St, Valemount, BC, consistent with OSM data; the contact page supplies a complete postal address matching the OSM street number. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields are null. The business is clearly operational with an active Shopify storefront and a 2026 copyright footer.
concerns: Internal inconsistency on the website: hours shown on the front page differ from those listed on the contact page.

OSM community tag assigns 'Unknown / Cariboo, Chilcotin & Central Interior' but Valemount is in the Robson Valley, typically associated with Thompson-Okanagan or Northern BC — may be miscategorized in the directory.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Vale Coffee is a real, operational café and roastery in Valemount with a confirmed address and active website — an appealing stop for touring cyclists in the Robson Valley.
